bande.kern: Striking, mature ideas; very well organised with a clear introduction, body and ending.
Relevant, interesting ideas; well organised and coherent.
Satisfactory ideas; reasonably organised, some lapses in clarity.
Ideas unclear or partly irrelevant; little planning or coherence.
Off topic or no recognisable plan; ideas repetitive or confused.
Tone, register and vocabulary fit perfectly; virtually error-free.
Very appropriate style; generally accurate, mostly free of errors.
Adequate style and vocabulary; errors do not block meaning.
Limited vocabulary; many errors; meaning sometimes unclear.
Error-ridden and confused; meaning seriously impaired.
Excellent development; paragraphs and sentences exceptionally well built.
Logical development; varied, well-built sentences and paragraphs.
Relevant details developed; essay still makes sense.
Some valid points; sentences and paragraphs faulty.
Undeveloped; sentences and paragraphs very faulty.

eat-longer-30.naam: English FAL longer transactional text rubric (30 marks)

bande.kern: Mature ideas; full knowledge of the text type; accurate format; stays on topic.
Good knowledge of the text type; focused; format with minor slips.
Adequate; some digressions; format generally right with some errors.
Basic; drifts off topic; format only vaguely applied.
No knowledge of the text type; format rules not applied.
Tone and register exactly right for purpose and audience; virtually error-free.
Very appropriate register; generally accurate.
Appropriate register; some grammar errors that do not block meaning.
Register less suitable; numerous errors.
Register wrong for the task; error-ridden.

eat-shorter-20.naam: English FAL shorter transactional text rubric (20 marks)

bande.kern: Full knowledge of the text type; all details support the task; accurate format.
Good knowledge of the text type; focused; minor format slips.
Adequate; some digressions; format partly right.
Basic; few supporting details; format vague.
No knowledge of the text type; no format.
Register exactly right; virtually error-free.
Very appropriate register; generally accurate.
Appropriate register; some errors.
Register less suitable; many errors.
Error-ridden; meaning impaired.

ht-opstel-50.naam: Afrikaans Huistaal: rubriek vir die opstel (50 punte)

bande.kern: Treffende, volwasse idees; uitstekend georden met inleiding, liggaam en slot.
Relevante, interessante idees; goed georden en samehangend.
Bevredigende idees; redelik georden, met enkele onduidelikhede.
Idees onduidelik of deels irrelevant; min beplanning.
Van die onderwerp af of sonder herkenbare plan.
Toon, register en woordkeuse pas presies; feitlik foutloos.
Baie gepaste styl; oor die algemeen korrek.
Toereikende styl; foute belemmer nie die betekenis nie.
Beperkte woordeskat; baie foute.
Vol foute; betekenis ernstig belemmer.
Uitstekende ontwikkeling; paragrawe en sinne uitstekend gebou.
Logiese ontwikkeling; gevarieerde sinne en paragrawe.
Relevante besonderhede ontwikkel; maak steeds sin.
Enkele geldige punte; sinne en paragrawe gebrekkig.
Onontwikkel; sinne en paragrawe baie gebrekkig.

ht-transaksioneel-25.naam: Afrikaans Huistaal: rubriek vir transaksionele tekste (25 punte)

Basies; dwaal af; formaat vaag toegepas.
Geen kennis van die teksoort; geen formaat.
Toon en register pas presies by doel en gehoor; feitlik foutloos.
Baie gepaste register; oor die algemeen korrek.
Gepaste register; enkele taalfoute.
Register minder gepas; talle foute.
Verkeerde register; vol foute.
